text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a busy few days, but it's finally
over...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to treat myself, I drag my tired
body to
the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Trainer! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were busy, but I didn't
expect you to
push yourself this hard.
choice_data_list: ネイチャ……？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't stand seeing you like this, so
here, let me
treat you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The shop's not open yet, so there aren't
any
customers. Why don't you wait in
the karaoke
section in the back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature brings me to the corner of a
bar.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know the lady who owns this place. She
said we
could use this space after I
explained the
situation.
choice_data_list: ここは……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll go make something simple... I can't
guarantee
it'll be good, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later, Nice Nature comes
back with
some fried rice.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She said I should feed you as much as
you need.
choice_data_list: こんなにいいのか？
こんなにいいの？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and start eating before it gets
cold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fried rice not only looks
professionally
prepared, but it tastes
like it too! I can't stop
eating.
choice_data_list: すごい、お店のメニューみたいだ！
すごい、お店のメニューみたい！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're so dramatic. It's just something I
picked up
from when I used to help my
mo—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! You've already finished?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No need for flattery. You must've been
starving.
Here, give me the plate.
choice_data_list: 美味しかったからつい

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch her as she leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I just ate so much,
but I start
to drift off...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: La... la la... ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...La la la... ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh? Did I wake you up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's a song my mom used to sing at the
counter. I
don't really know much
beyond the melody
though.
choice_data_list: ……その歌は？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking about those times and just
started
singing... Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You and your flattery again. It's not
necessary,
you know.
choice_data_list: むしろもっと聞いていたかった

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You and your flattery again. It's not
necessary,
you know.
choice_data_list: ネイチャの歌が好きなのは本当だし
この歌声ならライブもバッチリだな！
この歌声ならライブもバッチリだね！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, if you say so. You really are
strange...
choice_data_list: ネイチャの歌が好きなのは本当だし
この歌声ならライブもバッチリだな！
この歌声ならライブもバッチリだね！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But I'm relieved that you said you liked
it, instead
of saying my singing is "good."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That kind of pressure really gets to me,
you
know? It makes it all the worse when
I end up not
living up to such praise.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha, sorry for getting serious.
choice_data_list: ネイチャ……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What... You're crazy...
choice_data_list: そんなネイチャも好きだよ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You keep saying things like that, and
it'll lose its
meaning.

text_block_list.name: Bar Owner
text_block_list.text: Are you all done, Natie?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for letting us use the bar. It was a
huge
help.

text_block_list.name: Bar Owner
text_block_list.text:
You must be the trainer Natie's been
talking
about. She's told me so much
ab—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oookay! That's enough! Let's go,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: We're. Done. Here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The owner watches us warmly as we take
off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wow... You're still thinking about
winning
concerts even after working so
much?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This has been on my mind for a while
now, but...
aren't you pushing yourself a
little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I feel like you'll burn out if I don't keep
my eye on
you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I beg to differ.
choice_data_list: そんなことはないと思うけど

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
One sec. I'll go make you a rice ball for
later.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're just going to continue working
when you
get home, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey! At least pretend like you won't!
choice_data_list: バレてたか
バレてた？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the bar with a loving lecture and
a
late-night snack from Nice Nature.
